retreats.name: Kripalu Center for Yoga & Health
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-free culture encouraged
retreats.description2025: The largest yoga retreat center in North America, on 700 acres in the Berkshires. Phones aren't prohibited outright, but the culture strongly discourages them — no TVs in rooms, silent meals, a schedule that leaves no space for scrolling. Programs from weekend intensives to week-long trainings.

retreats.name: Omega Institute for Holistic Studies
retreats.techNote2025: Digital detox programs offered
retreats.description2025: A 250-acre Hudson Valley campus that explicitly names disconnection as a program category. One of the most beginner-welcoming retreat centers in the country — no TVs, slow dining, evening talks. Open May through October.

retreats.name: Insight Meditation Society (IMS)
retreats.techNote2025: Phones and devices not permitted during retreats
retreats.description2025: Founded in 1975 by Jack Kornfield, Sharon Salzberg, and Joseph Goldstein — one of the oldest and most respected vipassana centers in the West. Phones are collected at the start of every retreat. Donation-based (dana) pricing.

retreats.name: Sivananda Ashram Yoga Ranch
retreats.techNote2025: No TVs or internet in rooms; phones strongly discouraged
retreats.description2025: Classical ashram model: early morning meditation, twice-daily yoga, karma yoga, vegetarian meals. No WiFi in rooms, strong community expectation against phones. One of the most affordable residential retreat options in the Northeast.

retreats.name: The Garrison Institute
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-free common areas; minimal tech culture
retreats.description2025: A 19th-century monastery above the Hudson River, converted into a retreat center for contemplative practice and social transformation. Stone floors, chapel spaces, and river views create a natural invitation to slow down. Common areas are phone-free by culture.

retreats.name: Art of Living Retreat Center
retreats.techNote2025: Tech-free zones throughout campus
retreats.description2025: 380 acres in the Blue Ridge Mountains at 3,000 feet. Focused on Sri Sri Ravi Shankar's SKY Breath Meditation practices. Designated tech-free zones throughout campus. Ayurvedic spa on site. Programs for beginners through advanced practitioners.

retreats.name: Southern Dharma Retreat Center
retreats.techNote2025: Electronic devices not permitted during retreats
retreats.description2025: A small, intimate center offering silent meditation retreats since 1978. Phones, e-readers, and laptops are not permitted. Simple dormitory or cabin accommodations, vegetarian meals. Teachers come from Theravada, Tibetan, Zen, and non-sectarian traditions.

retreats.name: Esalen Institute
retreats.techNote2025: Very limited cell service; screen-free culture
retreats.description2025: Clinging to a cliff above the Pacific Ocean in Big Sur, with natural hot springs that flow into the sea. Limited cell service by geography, not just policy. Whatever program you attend, the location enforces the detox. Programs sell out months in advance.

retreats.name: 1440 Multiversity
retreats.techNote2025: Intentional digital disconnection; phone-free spaces
retreats.description2025: Founded specifically for people who need a break from a hyper-connected world — its name comes from the number of minutes in a day. Popular with tech-industry professionals. Designated phone-free areas throughout the Santa Cruz Mountains campus.

retreats.name: Spirit Rock Meditation Center
retreats.techNote2025: Phones and devices surrendered during residential retreats
retreats.description2025: West Coast counterpart to IMS in Barre — 411 rolling acres in a Marin County valley, teaching insight (vipassana) meditation since 1988. Phones collected at arrival for residential retreats. Teachers include Tara Brach, Jack Kornfield, and others. Donation-based.

retreats.name: Joshua Tree Retreat Center
retreats.techNote2025: Limited cell service; desert immersion culture
retreats.description2025: In the high desert near Joshua Tree National Park, hosting programs since the 1940s. Minimal cell service and an otherworldly landscape create a natural tech detox. Yoga trainings, sound healing, and plant medicine integration retreats. The stargazing alone is worth the trip.

retreats.name: Breitenbush Hot Springs
retreats.techNote2025: No cell service. No TVs. Worker-owned off-grid community.
retreats.description2025: The most reliably disconnected retreat on this list — not by policy, but because there is no cell service in the Cascade Mountain valley it occupies. A worker-owned cooperative operating geothermally off the grid since the 1980s. Hot springs flow 24 hours. Yoga, meditation, holistic healing workshops offered seasonally.

retreats.name: Cloud Mountain Retreat Center
retreats.techNote2025: Electronic devices not used during retreats
retreats.description2025: A small residential retreat center in southwestern Washington, offering silent meditation retreats since 1984 in the Theravada Buddhist tradition. Accommodates only 30-40 retreatants at a time — one of the more intimate options in the Pacific Northwest. Electronic devices not used during programs. Donation-based.

retreats.name: Drala Mountain Center (formerly Shambhala Mountain Center)
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free meditation halls; tech-minimal environment
retreats.description2025: 600 acres in the Colorado Rockies at 8,500 feet, home to the Great Stupa of Dharmakaya. Programs include Shambhala training, week-long sittings (weekthun), and month-long retreats (dathün). Meditation halls and common spaces are phone-free.

retreats.name: Tara Mandala Retreat Center
retreats.techNote2025: Remote mountain setting; minimal connectivity
retreats.description2025: Founded by Lama Tsultrim Allione, 700 acres in the San Juan Mountains. Emphasis on serious Vajrayana practice: dakini empowerments, chod practice. Remote high-altitude setting means connectivity is limited by circumstance as much as by culture.

retreats.name: Upaya Zen Center
retreats.techNote2025: Phones not used during silent and residential retreats
retreats.description2025: Founded by Roshi Joan Halifax, a Zen Buddhist temple in the foothills above Santa Fe. Blends contemplative practice with social engagement — death and dying work, environmental activism, prison dharma. Silent sesshins held throughout the year; phones not used. Adobe campus surrounded by piñon and juniper.

retreats.name: Miraval Arizona Resort & Spa
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free policy in all common areas
retreats.description2025: The high-end option on this list — an all-inclusive wellness resort with an explicit phone-free policy in shared spaces. Programming includes equine therapy, meditation, and life balance workshops. Phones allowed in rooms, but the culture makes you want to leave it there. Set against the Santa Catalina Mountains north of Tucson.

retreats.name: Feathered Pipe Ranch
retreats.techNote2025: Remote mountain setting; minimal connectivity; screen-free culture
retreats.description2025: Running yoga retreats in the Montana Rockies since 1975, hosted by teachers including B.K.S. Iyengar, Ram Dass, and Pema Chödrön historically. 110-acre property at 5,000 feet with a private lake and glacier-carved landscape. Summer programs only. Genuinely unplugged culture.

retreats.name: Plum Village
retreats.techNote2025: Phones not used during retreat periods — Noble Silence
retreats.description2025: The most internationally recognized Buddhist retreat center in Europe, founded by Thich Nhat Hanh in 1982. Three monasteries in the Dordogne countryside, drawing practitioners from 90+ countries. Noble Silence maintained throughout. Retreat weeks from around €500-700.

retreats.name: Centre Lerab Ling
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free during all programs
retreats.description2025: Rigpa's main European retreat center in the limestone hills of southern France. Large Tibetan shrine hall consecrated by the Dalai Lama. Remote Languedoc setting makes digital disconnection feel effortless. Programs range from short retreats to major annual teaching events.

retreats.name: Amaravati Buddhist Monastery
retreats.location: Great Gaddesden, Hertfordshire (~40 miles from London)
retreats.techNote2025: Phones collected at arrival — Noble Silence
retreats.description2025: A fully residential Thai Forest monastery founded in 1984. Phones collected at arrival, Noble Silence throughout. One of the most beginner-welcoming silent retreat centers in England. Offered on a dana (donation) basis — one of the most financially accessible options in Europe.

retreats.name: Gaia House
retreats.location: West Ogwell, Devon (~3 hours from London)
retreats.techNote2025: Phones collected at retreat start — Noble Silence throughout
retreats.description2025: England's most established Western insight meditation center, in the countryside near Newton Abbot, Devon. Phones collected at start of every retreat. Lineage follows IMS (Barre, MA). Retreats from 2-day weekends to month-long programs, many welcoming beginners.

retreats.name: The Sharpham Trust
retreats.techNote2025: Screens and devices strongly discouraged during retreats
retreats.description2025: An 18th-century Palladian manor on the River Dart near Totnes. Programs from silent mindfulness intensives to creative and movement-based retreats. Located 15-20 minutes from Gaia House — Devon's remarkable retreat cluster. The Dart estuary setting naturally reinforces disconnection.

retreats.name: Samye Ling Tibetan Centre
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free during retreat programs
retreats.description2025: The first Tibetan Buddhist center established in the Western world (founded 1967). Considered the largest Buddhist monastery in Western Europe, with an ornate Tibetan temple in the remote Scottish hills. Phone-free during organized programs. About 1.5 hours from Glasgow or Edinburgh by car.

retreats.name: Dzogchen Beara
retreats.techNote2025: Devices not used during retreat programs
retreats.description2025: Perched on the cliffs of the Beara Peninsula overlooking the Atlantic — one of the most strikingly located retreat centers in Europe. Part of the Rigpa organization. Programs include organized retreat weeks and personal retreat accommodation. About 2.5 hours from Cork Airport.

retreats.name: Sakya Tashi Ling
retreats.location: Garraf Natural Park, near Barcelona, Catalonia
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free during retreat programs
retreats.description2025: A significant Tibetan Buddhist monastery in the Garraf Natural Park near Olivella, about 40 km southwest of Barcelona. Striking Himalayan architecture in a Mediterranean limestone landscape. Programs in Catalan, Spanish, and English. Accessible from Barcelona El Prat Airport in about 45 minutes.

retreats.name: Suryalila Retreat Center
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-minimal yoga retreat culture
retreats.description2025: A yoga retreat center in the hills of Cadiz province near the Sierra de Grazalema Natural Park. Known for Jivamukti and alignment-based yoga teacher trainings. All programs in English, drawing international participants. The Andalusian landscape (olive groves, white villages, mountains) reinforces the disconnection.

retreats.name: Osho Miasto
retreats.location: Pomarance, near Volterra, Province of Pisa, Tuscany
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-minimal during programs
retreats.description2025: An Osho meditation community in the Tuscan hills near Volterra, combining silent sitting and active meditation (Dynamic Meditation, Kundalini) with bodywork and expressive arts. International programs in English. The Tuscan landscape and immersive community schedule create a naturally screen-minimal environment.

retreats.name: Istituto Lama Tzong Khapa (ILTK)
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free during retreat periods
retreats.description2025: Founded in 1977, part of FPMT. One of the most respected Tibetan Buddhist study and practice centers in Europe, with a resident monastic community in the Tuscan hills south of Pisa. Offers everything from beginner introductions to multi-year study programs. About 1 hour from Pisa Airport.

retreats.name: Suan Mokkh International Dharma Hermitage
retreats.techNote2025: Phones surrendered at arrival — Noble Silence throughout
retreats.description2025: Monthly 10-day donation-based silent retreats in a forest garden. One of the most established and affordable silent retreats in Asia — draws practitioners from 50+ countries each month. Phones collected on arrival.

retreats.name: Samahita Retreat
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-minimal; dedicated digital detox programs
retreats.description2025: Clifftop yoga and vipassana retreat on the south side of Koh Samui overlooking the Gulf of Thailand. Programs in English. Dedicated digital detox offerings alongside yoga immersions and vipassana retreats.

retreats.name: The Yoga Barn
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-minimal culture; screen-free common areas
retreats.description2025: Ubud's most established yoga center, set among rice paddies. Multiple daily classes, healer's corner, organic café. Drop-in classes welcome. Retreat programs up to multi-week teacher trainings. Genuinely phone-minimal by culture.

retreats.name: COMO Shambhala Estate
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-minimal spa and program culture throughout
retreats.description2025: Luxury wellness estate above the Ayung River gorge. Ayurvedic programs, yoga, meditation, and spa in a deeply mindful jungle setting. Considered one of Asia's most respected wellness retreats. Phone-minimal by culture.

retreats.name: Fivelements
retreats.techNote2025: Eco-retreat culture; screen-minimal throughout
retreats.description2025: Eco-luxury retreat on the Ayung River designed as a traditional Balinese water palace. Balinese healing traditions, plant-based cuisine, sound healing, yoga. Bamboo pavilions, river soundscapes, ceremonial incense — a natural container for stepping away from screens.

retreats.name: Tushita Meditation Centre
retreats.techNote2025: Phones not permitted during retreat courses
retreats.description2025: FPMT Tibetan Buddhist center in the forest above McLeod Ganj, 2km from the Dalai Lama's monastery. The 10-day Introduction to Buddhism course is one of Asia's most popular retreat programs for international visitors. Phones not used during courses. Donation-based.

retreats.name: Parmarth Niketan Ashram
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-minimal; Ganga Aarti creates phone-free culture by nature
retreats.description2025: One of the largest and most respected ashrams on the Ganges in Rishikesh. Daily yoga, meditation, Vedic chanting, and the famous dawn and dusk Ganga Aarti fire ceremony. International visitors welcome. Programs in English and Hindi.

retreats.name: Ananda in the Himalayas
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-minimal; screen-free spa and program spaces
retreats.description2025: Luxury Ayurvedic retreat in a restored Maharaja's palace above the Ganges valley. One of the world's leading Ayurvedic wellness resorts, integrating Ayurveda, yoga, and Vedanta philosophy. Phone-minimal throughout; screen-free program and spa spaces.

retreats.name: Koyasan (Kōya-san) Temple Town
retreats.techNote2025: Temple culture; phones not used during morning ceremonies
retreats.description2025: UNESCO World Heritage sacred mountain town — center of Shingon Buddhism since 816 AD. Over 100 temples offer shukubo (temple lodging) with vegetarian meals and morning ceremonies. Accessible from Osaka by train + cable car (~1.5 hours). Naturally screen-minimal by atmosphere.

retreats.name: Shunkoin Temple Zen Retreat
retreats.techNote2025: Phone-free during all meditation sessions
retreats.description2025: Sub-temple within Kyoto's largest Zen complex (47 temples, 35 acres). English-language Zen meditation programs and mindfulness workshops for international visitors. One of the most accessible entry points to Zen practice in Japan. 15 minutes from Kyoto Station by bus.

retreats.name: Kopan Monastery
retreats.techNote2025: Phones not used during retreat courses
retreats.description2025: FPMT Tibetan Buddhist monastery on a hilltop overlooking Kathmandu and Boudhanath Stupa. Monthly 10-day lamrim (graduated path) meditation courses for beginners — among the most popular structured retreat programs in Nepal. Phones not used during courses. Views of the Himalayas on clear days.

retreats.name: Nilambe Buddhist Meditation Centre
retreats.techNote2025: No electronic devices during retreats — Noble Silence
retreats.description2025: Simple, donation-based retreat center in the tea-country hills above Kandy, operating since the 1970s. Electronic devices not used during retreats. Very basic accommodation. One of the most authentic and financially accessible retreat experiences in South Asia. About 30 minutes from Kandy by car.

retreats.name: Willka T'ika
retreats.location: Urubamba, Sacred Valley of the Incas
retreats.techNote2025: Screen-minimal; Andean landscape commands full attention
retreats.description2025: Award-winning retreat center in the Sacred Valley between Cusco and Machu Picchu, with seven Andean chakra gardens and views of snowcapped peaks. Programs blend yoga, meditation, and Andean healing traditions. English-language programs. At 2,800m elevation, the altitude and landscape create a naturally screen-minimal environment.

retreats.name: Yachana Lodge
retreats.techNote2025: No cell service in the Amazon jungle — tech-free by geography
retreats.description2025: Eco-lodge deep in the Ecuadorian Amazon, accessible only by motorized canoe. No cell service by geography — not by policy. Guided jungle walks, indigenous community visits, canoe expeditions. Profits support local community development. About 3 hours from Quito by road + canoe.
